newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 4.1 bln levs rollover T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 4.1 bln levs rollover T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry has placed a rollover issue of 4.1 billion levs worth of floater coupon three-month T-bills, yielding 69.39 percent until maturity, a Finance Ministry official said.

"The ministry placed the issue with the State Savings Bank on Wednesday to meet maturity and interest payments on government securities," a Finance ministry official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
The coupon equals the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at 15 percent monthly or 180 percent annually.
On Wednesday the Finance Ministry had to pay 12.5-13 billion levs principal and interest on treasury paper issues, the Finance Ministry official said.
Part of that payment was met by the sale of some 8.8 billion levs worth of three-month floater coupon T-bills auctioned on Monday.
